name: prescan_warm
description: Quick WARM pre-scan centered on the whole-area sweet spot (iters_initial~50, radius 0.12, warm-start). Coarsely co-varies initial-model strength (iters_initial x n_train), retrain budget (iters_retrain), and the selection axes (sel_sigma, n_select, mix_ratio) to find which OTHER parameters/ranges move the whole-area guided-vs-random win now that the anchor moved. 3 iters_initial x 3 n_train x 2 sel_sigma x 2 n_select x 2 mix x 2 iters_retrain x 2 seeds = 288 configs, top-3 detectors.
